how_chosen: citation-walk.v1.html pinLabel uses MODEL.pinLabels[pinId] when that key is present, and otherwise pinId@version. presentation_projection.py fills pinLabels only for a numeric source-fact leaf, from that finding's evidence label.
why_raw_id: On this page pinLabels is empty, so every button is the fallback. v91 draws no button on line 6c or the top entry because those sections are the two parked alerts. v92 draws one button on each: the field citation. Neither citation id is a numeric source-fact finding, so the projection does not store a word for it.
what_makes_it_read_as_the_others: The other buttons on this page are already id@version. The two buttons v92 adds use that same fallback. A word would appear only if pinLabels held an evidence label under that pin id. A field citation is not a finding, so the citation citizen has no evidence label to contribute. The page stays as published.
